MOT17-04-FRCNN.name: far_walkway
MOT17-04-FRCNN.note: Alarm when a person walks INTO the far end of the street from the camera side, i.e. crosses the near (bottom, row 330) edge moving up the image = away from the camera, within 60 degrees. People coming out of the far end or stepping in sideways from the shop fronts / the right kerb are logged as non-alarm ENTRY. Image 'up' is the walking direction along the street axis, which recedes toward the top of the image.

MOT17-04-FRCNN.name: near_plaza
MOT17-04-FRCNN.note: Alarm when a person comes down the street toward the camera and crosses the far (top, row 780) edge of the area below the camera inward (edge 0 = vertex 0 -> 1, inward normal = image down), within 60 degrees. People stepping in from the left pavement or from the right (cones) side are logged as ENTRY.

MOT17-09-FRCNN.name: far_storefront
MOT17-09-FRCNN.note: Alarm when a person turns off the open pavement toward the far shop entrance, i.e. crosses the front (bottom, edge 2 = vertex 2 -> 3, rows 720-735) edge inward = moving up the image, within 60 degrees. Walking along the pavement past the shops (mostly sideways in the image) into or through the strip is logged as ENTRY.

MOT17-09-FRCNN.name: near_entrance
MOT17-09-FRCNN.note: Alarm when a person walks from the open pavement straight toward the near shop door, i.e. crosses the front (bottom, edge 2 = vertex 2 -> 3, rows 900-960) edge inward = moving up the image (away from the camera), within 60 degrees. Passers-by entering the strip from the left or the right side are logged as ENTRY.

MOT17-04-FRCNN.name: mid_street
MOT17-04-FRCNN.note: Counting line across the whole pedestrian street at mid depth (row 620, between the far band ending at row 330 and the near area starting at row 780), from the yellow tactile strip on the left (x 200) to the kerb with the cones on the right (x 1480). LINE_CROSS when a person crosses it walking toward the camera (image down); crossing away from the camera raises nothing.

MOT17-09-FRCNN.name: pavement
MOT17-09-FRCNN.note: Counting line across the pavement between the near and the far shop entrance (column 1250, from the shop-front floor line at row 745 to the bottom edge). LINE_CROSS when a person crosses it walking right, i.e. deeper along the pavement toward the far entrance; crossing toward the camera side (left) raises nothing.
